paragraphs: Keefe Group supplies food products, personal care products, electronics, clothing, technology, telecommunications and software solutions to correctional facilities across the nation. The affiliates named on the homepage are Keefe Commissary Network, Access Securepak, Access Corrections, ICSolutions and Advanced Technologies Group.

The products page presents Access Securepak as a one-stop shop for inmates' family and friends to send food, personal care products, clothing, shoes and electronics. Those care packages are described as helping keep contraband out of correctional facilities. The same page lists three kiosk styles, booking, lobby and pod, and describes technology for how correctional facilities manage information, financial transactions and entertainment for inmates and their families.

The products page names private-label brands and name-brand partners as the sources of products reaching the correctional market. Keefe Group has served the correctional market since 1975, according to the homepage.

quote.text: Since 1975, Keefe has serviced the correctional market exclusively and pioneered the evolution of products, packaging and technology services
